note: Golden vectors for the pure circulation-policy resolver. Run by node --test here and by cargo test in the offline Rust core (phase 77). Expectations are NOT produced by the implementation: rank uses bit shifts, time uses a one-minute linear scan over Intl, and civil-date arithmetic steps a day at a time. See scripts/build-vectors.ts.
